text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The morning of the Takarazuka Kinen. 
Reporter Otonashi conducts an interview
in 
the empty stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has high expectations for
<chrname>. 
Cheers from fans erupted one after
another 
for the girl about to take flight from 
Japan onto the world stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now, win the Takarazuka Kinen and give 
people even more to dream about.
<chrname> heads 
toward the showdown—
